FactorKind.description:
The kind of edit an experiment factor makes on each of its nodes.

``agent`` answers an llm node with another agent of the project, ``prompt`` replaces the prompt text of an llm
node, ``use`` replaces a node with an alternative node of the experiment, ``flow`` points a call node at
another flow.
FactorKind.title: FactorKind

description:
The one factor the variants of an experiment change: ``what`` kind of edit on which ``nodes`` of the subject.

``nodes`` lists local node ids of the subject flow, each once; a nested node is named by its own id. Every
variant sets values of this factor only, so a series tells which edit made the difference.
title: ExperimentFactor
